title: KillerPlugin
description: A lightweight Minecraft plugin that adds a complete bounty system. Wanted, bounty, and player tracking are all at your fingertips. Here, everyone is a killer.
body:
**Killer - Assassin**
Hi~ Welcome to Killer!

In this plugin, everyone can be an assassin—kill wanted players and earn experience rewards.
Obtain the drop permission from an administrator to gain the ability to issue wanted notices!

Here is a detailed introduction:

✨** Features**

🔴 Wanted Players - /dp <player> <xp> <description>

🟢 Cancel Wanted - /udp <player>

📋 View List - /wl to view online wanted players

📍 Track Location - /gps <player> to get wanted player coordinates

🛡️ Permission Management - Grant/remove drop permissions

🚫 Wanted Protection - Set players who cannot be wanted

✏️ Modify Wanted - Modify bounty or description

📖 Full Help - /killerhelp

🔧 **Technical Features**
Data persistence (not lost after restart)

Permission system support

Earn experience rewards by killing wanted players

Full-server warnings when wanted players log in

📥 **Installation**
Place killer.jar into the plugins folder

Restart the server

The configuration file will be automatically generated at plugins/killer/config.yml

Modify the configuration as needed

Requires Minecraft 1.16+

Uses Spigot/Paper server

👤 **Author**
@NightZero
